review: en, sl, it, de: machine-written (Claude), not reviewed by a native speaker

description.en: The guests at the Packhorse Inn come from everywhere, and Mrs Birkett hears every story: the journey, the luggage, the delays at the airport, the campsite and the hostel, and the souvenirs they take home.
description.sl: Gostje v gostilni Packhorse prihajajo od vsepovsod in gospa Birkett sliši vsako zgodbo: potovanje, prtljaga, zamude na letališču, kamp in hostel ter spominki, ki jih odnesejo domov.
description.it: Gli ospiti del Packhorse Inn arrivano da ogni parte e la signora Birkett sente ogni storia: il viaggio, i bagagli, i ritardi all'aeroporto, il campeggio e l'ostello, e i souvenir che portano a casa.
description.de: Die Gäste im Packhorse Inn kommen von überall, und Mrs Birkett hört jede Geschichte: die Reise, das Gepäck, die Verspätungen am Flughafen, den Campingplatz und die Herberge und die Souvenirs, die sie mitnehmen.

words.example_en: The journey from London to Keswick takes about five hours.
words.example_sl: Potovanje iz Londona do Keswicka traja približno pet ur.
words.example_it: Il viaggio da Londra a Keswick dura circa cinque ore.
words.example_de: Die Reise von London nach Keswick dauert etwa fünf Stunden.
words.note: A journey is going from one place to another; a trip is the whole outing, there and back.
words.note_sl: Journey je pot od kraja do kraja; trip je ves izlet, tja in nazaj.
words.note_it: Journey è lo spostamento; trip è tutta la gita, andata e ritorno.
words.note_de: Journey ist die Fahrt von A nach B; trip der ganze Ausflug, hin und zurück.

words.example_en: The school is going on a trip to the Pencil Museum.
words.example_sl: Šola gre na izlet v muzej svinčnikov.
words.example_it: La scuola va in gita al museo delle matite.
words.example_de: Die Schule macht einen Ausflug ins Bleistiftmuseum.

words.example_en: We're going on holiday to Scotland in June.
words.example_sl: Junija gremo na počitnice na Škotsko.
words.example_it: A giugno andiamo in vacanza in Scozia.
words.example_de: Im Juni fahren wir in den Urlaub nach Schottland.
words.note: British holiday, American vacation. A bank holiday is a public day off.
words.note_sl: Britansko holiday, ameriško vacation. A bank holiday je državni praznik.
words.note_it: Britannico holiday, americano vacation. A bank holiday è un giorno festivo.
words.note_de: Britisch holiday, amerikanisch vacation. A bank holiday ist ein Feiertag.

words.example_en: Leave your luggage in the hall and I'll show you your room.
words.example_sl: Prtljago pusti v veži, pokazala ti bom sobo.
words.example_it: Lascia i bagagli nell'ingresso, ti mostro la camera.
words.example_de: Lass dein Gepäck im Flur, ich zeige dir dein Zimmer.
words.note: Luggage is uncountable: a lot of luggage, a piece of luggage.
words.note_sl: Luggage je neštevno: a lot of luggage, a piece of luggage.
words.note_it: Luggage non si conta: a lot of luggage, a piece of luggage.
words.note_de: Luggage ist unzählbar: a lot of luggage, a piece of luggage.

words.example_en: Her suitcase was so heavy that Sam had to carry it upstairs.
words.example_sl: Njen kovček je bil tako težak, da ga je moral Sam nesti gor.
words.example_it: La sua valigia era così pesante che Sam ha dovuto portarla di sopra.
words.example_de: Ihr Koffer war so schwer, dass Sam ihn nach oben tragen musste.

words.example_en: Don't forget your passport, we're flying from Manchester.
words.example_sl: Ne pozabi potnega lista, letimo iz Manchestra.
words.example_it: Non dimenticare il passaporto, partiamo in aereo da Manchester.
words.example_de: Vergiss deinen Reisepass nicht, wir fliegen ab Manchester.

words.example_en: We booked a room at the inn for three nights.
words.example_sl: V gostilni smo rezervirali sobo za tri noči.
words.example_it: Abbiamo prenotato una camera alla locanda per tre notti.
words.example_de: Wir haben ein Zimmer im Gasthaus für drei Nächte gebucht.

words.example_en: Edna still books her holidays through a travel agent in Penrith.
words.example_sl: Edna še vedno rezervira počitnice pri potovalnem agentu v Penrithu.
words.example_it: Edna prenota ancora le vacanze da un agente di viaggio a Penrith.
words.example_de: Edna bucht ihre Urlaube immer noch über ein Reisebüro in Penrith.

words.example_en: The train to Carlisle leaves from platform two.
words.example_sl: Vlak za Carlisle odpelje s perona dva.
words.example_it: Il treno per Carlisle parte dal binario due.
words.example_de: Der Zug nach Carlisle fährt von Bahnsteig zwei ab.

words.example_en: There's a delay of forty minutes because of the snow.
words.example_sl: Zaradi snega je štirideset minut zamude.
words.example_it: C'è un ritardo di quaranta minuti per la neve.
words.example_de: Wegen des Schnees gibt es vierzig Minuten Verspätung.

words.example_en: The ferry was cancelled because of the wind.
words.example_sl: Trajekt so zaradi vetra odpovedali.
words.example_it: Il traghetto è stato cancellato per il vento.
words.example_de: Die Fähre wurde wegen des Windes abgesagt.
words.note: British cancelled, cancelling (two l's); American canceled.

words.example_en: Jack has never been abroad, but he has been to Scotland.
words.example_sl: Jack še nikoli ni bil v tujini, je pa bil na Škotskem.
words.example_it: Jack non è mai stato all'estero, ma è stato in Scozia.
words.example_de: Jack war noch nie im Ausland, aber in Schottland schon.
words.note: Abroad has no to or in: go abroad, live abroad.
words.note_sl: Abroad nima to ali in: go abroad, live abroad.
words.note_it: Abroad senza to o in: go abroad, live abroad.
words.note_de: Abroad ohne to oder in: go abroad, live abroad.

words.example_en: We did some sightseeing in Edinburgh before the wedding.
words.example_sl: Pred poroko smo si v Edinburghu ogledali znamenitosti.
words.example_it: Prima del matrimonio abbiamo fatto un po' di visite turistiche a Edimburgo.
words.example_de: Vor der Hochzeit haben wir in Edinburgh ein paar Besichtigungen gemacht.

words.example_en: Wainwright's guidebooks are still in every walker's rucksack.
words.example_sl: Wainwrightovi vodniki so še vedno v nahrbtniku vsakega pohodnika.
words.example_it: Le guide di Wainwright sono ancora nello zaino di ogni escursionista.
words.example_de: Wainwrights Reiseführer stecken noch immer in jedem Wanderrucksack.

words.example_en: She bought a tin of Kendal mint cake as a souvenir.
words.example_sl: Kot spominek je kupila škatlo mentolovega kolača iz Kendala.
words.example_it: Ha comprato una scatola di Kendal mint cake come souvenir.
words.example_de: Sie hat eine Dose Kendal Mint Cake als Andenken gekauft.

words.example_en: The youth hostel in Borrowdale is full of walkers in summer.
words.example_sl: Mladinski hostel v Borrowdalu je poleti poln pohodnikov.
words.example_it: D'estate l'ostello della gioventù di Borrowdale è pieno di escursionisti.
words.example_de: Die Jugendherberge in Borrowdale ist im Sommer voller Wanderer.

words.example_en: The campsite by the lake has hot showers and a little shop.
words.example_sl: Kamp ob jezeru ima tople prhe in majhno trgovino.
words.example_it: Il campeggio vicino al lago ha docce calde e un negozietto.
words.example_de: Der Campingplatz am See hat warme Duschen und einen kleinen Laden.

words.example_en: Have you packed your waterproof? It'll rain on the way.
words.example_sl: Si spakiral nepremočljivo jakno? Na poti bo deževalo.
words.example_it: Hai messo in valigia la giacca impermeabile? Pioverà per strada.
words.example_de: Hast du deine Regenjacke eingepackt? Unterwegs wird es regnen.

words.example_en: Unpack your things and come down for supper.
words.example_sl: Razpakiraj stvari in pridi dol na večerjo.
words.example_it: Disfa la valigia e scendi per la cena.
words.example_de: Pack deine Sachen aus und komm zum Abendessen runter.

words.example_en: Our flight to Belfast was delayed by two hours.
words.example_sl: Naš let v Belfast je imel dve uri zamude.
words.example_it: Il nostro volo per Belfast ha avuto due ore di ritardo.
words.example_de: Unser Flug nach Belfast hatte zwei Stunden Verspätung.

words.example_en: The nearest big airport is Manchester, two hours away.
words.example_sl: Najbližje veliko letališče je Manchester, dve uri stran.
words.example_it: L'aeroporto grande più vicino è Manchester, a due ore.
words.example_de: Der nächste große Flughafen ist Manchester, zwei Stunden entfernt.

words.example_en: A coach full of tourists stopped outside the inn.
words.example_sl: Pred gostilno se je ustavil turistični avtobus, poln turistov.
words.example_it: Un pullman pieno di turisti si è fermato davanti alla locanda.
words.example_de: Ein Reisebus voller Touristen hielt vor dem Gasthaus.
words.note: A coach is a long-distance bus; a coach is also a sports trainer.
words.note_sl: Coach je avtobus za daljše razdalje; coach je tudi trener.
words.note_it: Coach è un pullman; coach è anche l'allenatore.
words.note_de: Coach ist ein Reisebus; coach ist auch ein Trainer.

words.example_en: Edna sends a postcard to her sister from every trip.
words.example_sl: Edna sestri z vsakega izleta pošlje razglednico.
words.example_it: Edna manda una cartolina alla sorella da ogni viaggio.
words.example_de: Edna schickt ihrer Schwester von jeder Reise eine Postkarte.

words.example_en: When she retires, she wants to travel round Ireland.
words.example_sl: Ko se upokoji, hoče potovati po Irski.
words.example_it: Quando andrà in pensione vuole viaggiare per l'Irlanda.
words.example_de: Wenn sie in Rente geht, will sie durch Irland reisen.
words.note: British travelling, travelled (two l's); American traveling.
